facts.fact: If in immediate danger, call 112, the emergency number
facts.quote: Legal (NALSA) Helpline : 15100 For Emergency : 112 Tele Manas : 14416

facts.fact: The Women Helpline 181 is toll-free and works 24 hours, and connects women to the Emergency Response Support System (police/fire/ambulance) and One Stop Centres
facts.quote: The Women Helpline provides toll-free 24-hours telecom service to women seeking support and information by connecting them with Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) for all emergency services like police/ fire/ Ambulance services and with One Stop Centres.

facts.fact: 181 gives 24x7 response to women facing violence at home or outside and links them to police, One Stop Centres, hospitals and legal services
facts.quote: aims to provide 24x7x365 emergency and non-emergency response through telephonic short-code 181 to women, both in public and private spaces by linking them with appropriate authorities such as Police, One Stop Centres, Hospitals, Legal Services Authorities etc.

facts.fact: 181 also gives information about women's welfare schemes
facts.quote: Additionally, it provides information about women welfare schemes and programs.

facts.fact: One Stop Centres are popularly known as Sakhi Centres
facts.quote: One Stop Centre(OSC) scheme, popularly known as Sakhi Centres, is being implemented across the country since 1st April 2015.

facts.fact: One Stop Centres are set up in each district of the country
facts.quote: Presently, OSCs are being set up in each district of the country.

facts.fact: One Stop Centres give medical aid, legal aid and advice, temporary shelter, police assistance and psycho-social counselling under one roof
facts.quote: It also provides an integrated range of services including medical aid, legal aid and advice, temporary shelter, police assistance, psycho-social counselling to needy women.

facts.fact: The nearest One Stop Centre can be found via 'Find Nearest Institute', and an OSC visit booked via 'Book Appointment for OSC', on missionshakti.wcd.gov.in
facts.quote: Feedback/Grievance Contact Us Find Nearest Institute Book Appointment for OSC Gender Budgeting Knowledge Hub

facts.fact: Other help: NALSA legal aid helpline 15100 and Tele-MANAS 14416 (mental health)
facts.quote: Legal (NALSA) Helpline : 15100 For Emergency : 112 Tele Manas : 14416

summary: Mission Shakti page and guidelines confirm 112, 181 (toll-free 24x7, links to police/OSC/hospital/legal), OSC (Sakhi) services and finder, NALSA 15100, Tele-MANAS 14416.
